data.narrative:
Abridge is a Series E–stage company in Biotech & Health that has raised $1.2B+ and carries a last post-money valuation of $5.3B. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers across public and private markets: three publicly traded companies (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and seven private firms including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, and Freenome, spanning valuations from $1.1B to $10.3B.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, applying a typical 1.4x step-up multiplier from Series E onward to the $5.3B base, implies a forward valuation of $7.4B. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, similar-tier comparables yields a median of $3.1B, with a range spanning $1.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring using the Biotech & Health sector's 5.6x median price-to-sales multiple cannot be applied due to absence of target revenue disclosure, standard practice for private companies.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $2.6B (low) to $8.5B (high), with a median of $5.3B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty: the peer-median method anchors to $3.1B, roughly 40% below the current valuation, while stage-progression suggests $7.4B. Key sensitivities include revenue scale and profitability trajectory—neither of which are specified in available data—and relative positioning among the wide-ranging peer set.
